body: A source review of mask candidate986512b6 found a liveness blocker. Successful synchronous callback can buffer new brush samples into flight.brushSamples; defer appends then only calls onNeedsFlush?(), which is nil in the supported immediate-fallback case, leaving edits pending indefinitely. Reentrant group/param/component requestFlush similarly reaches in-flight guard with no post-success drain. Existing seven tests manually flush again, so do not prove accepted follow-on liveness. Please correct with bounded asynchronous follow-on drain for accepted reentrant work (both nil handler and synchronous handler), never automatic retry after any failed batch. Invalidate stale queued drains before a later explicit consuming flush, so an intervening rejection cannot be auto-retried by an obsolete task. Add deterministic tests including second-generation accepted updates and queued-drain invalidation, with no fixed sleeps. Keep changes in mask extension/new test file; do not touch A DevelopController.swift/AppModel. Tests still UNRUN on B; preserve current tests/product commits. Publish revised source candidate and exact limits. B no-workload/paused-heartbeat hold unchanged. A owns compilation/merge. Initial result48f8e3c2 is not accepted product until this review issue is addressed.
